title: Bentwaters/Rendlesham 1980 multi-witness incident
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Bentwaters/Rendlesham 1980 multi-witness incident, about 1980 at RAF Bentwaters, England, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

And you had uh uh Colonel Charles Halt as well do do an investigation afterwards and everything checked.
tellings.difference: Adds that Halt's investigation afterwards found that everything checked out.
